_about: AI-assisted: reviewed and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Thirty-one manually gated Kingpin Act sanctions-only people from a deterministic 100-row unreviewed SDNTK/SDNT cohort. Same-UID current listing, original action add section, XML Created date, annual archive identity, and person-naming Treasury release corroborated. No conviction, operational role, group, drug, country association, person-to-person link, or portrait inferred. First-listed date and 2026-09-23 current status are separate claims.
